messages:
ari-fin: Flagging an odd case: customer Orbitix (acct 2104) got two invoices this morning with same invoice_id INV-2026-09-12-2104. One includes a regional surtax line (TX_SURTAX_01), the other omits it. Also, vendor_integration_fee appears twice on the paid invoice.

noah-billing: I pulled the render logs. renderer ran twice for that invoice_id. First render included surtax and single vendor fee. Second render (retry) dropped surtax because tax-service returned 404 for jurisdiction lookup, but duplicated vendor fee due to webhook replay from vendor system. Both PDFs were emailed.

tax-bot: Tax service event: lookup_failure account=2104 jurisdiction=tx-rtx status=404 at 09:07:14. Subsequent cache clear at 09:07:20.

ari-fin: Customer already paid the larger total (with duplicate vendor fee). We need to void the overcharge and issue a credit memo for the duplicate vendor fee and any processing fees. Also want a short CS note.

claudia-cs: Customer on the thread says they were charged twice for the vendor fee and wants the extra refunded. Please confirm timeline and remediation.

ops-vee: Quick hypothesis: vendor webhook replayed a successful_fee_applied event and our invoices service applied vendor_integration_fee on both renders because dedupe by event_id is missing for that integration. Tax lookup failure then caused the surtax to be omitted on retry. So two root causes.

noah-billing: SQL to inspect invoice lines and related events:
```
SELECT il.invoice_id, il.code, il.amount_cents, e.event_id, e.processed_at
FROM invoice_lines il
LEFT JOIN vendor_events e ON e.account_id = il.account_id AND e.batch_id = il.batch_id
WHERE il.account_id = 2104 AND il.batch_date = '2026-09-12' AND il.invoice_id = 'INV-2026-09-12-2104'
ORDER BY il.created_at;
```

ari-fin: Payment check: payment_id=pay_q1w2 processed at 09:12. Looks like the higher total was paid. We'll need to issue credit. Finance signoff?

noah-billing: Proposed remediation steps: 1) pause outbound invoice emails for that batch to avoid confusing duplicates, 2) backfill tax-service lookup (rehydrate cache) and run a targeted re-render for invoice_id INV-2026-09-12-2104 with `--ensure-tax` flag, 3) dedupe vendor events by event_id and add idempotency checks in vendor fee insertion path, 4) issue credit memo for duplicate vendor fee and cover processing fees.

ari-fin: Finance approves credit memo and processing fee coverage. Please CC finance@redwood on the memo and include a short note template.

ops-vee: I'll queue the re-render and mark the duplicate PDF as retracted in S3. Also will open an ops ticket to throttle vendor webhook retries if event_id not present.

dev-jun: I'll open a PR to add vendor_event dedupe (store event_id unique index) and update invoice pipeline to require tax preflight success before commit. Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/5123. Adding unit tests.

billing-bot: manual-regenerate queued: job=regen-2026-09-12-2104 requested_by=ops-vee ETA=3m

billing-bot: regen completed: job=regen-2026-09-12-2104 status=completed results: invoice corrected, credit_memo=CM-2026-09-12-2104 amount=1500 cents processed=true pdfs_replaced=true

ari-fin: Confirmed credit memo issued for duplicate vendor fee (1200 cents) + processing fee cover (300 cents). CS notified and sent apology note. Customer acknowledged.

noah-billing: Postmortem items: add webhook dedupe, preflight tax check, and a smoke test to detect multiple PDFs for same invoice_id with different tax lines. Also alert on vendor_event replay rate. Filing FIN-INV-427.

dev-jun: PR merged to staging. Scheduling production deploy in the emergency window.

ops-vee: Closing loop. Will monitor for any other vendor duplicate events in the last 24h.

claudia-cs: Thanks team. Customer happy with credit and explanation. Closing thread.
